articles.headline: Deni Avdija scores 28 points in the Trail Blazers' 118-110 win over the Nuggets
articles.description: — Deni Avdija scored nine of his 28 points in the fourth quarter and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the Denver Nuggets 118-110 on Monday night, extending their road winning streak to begin the season.

articles.headline: Harper, Wembanyama lead Spurs past Jazz 119-97, extend winning streak to 5 games
articles.description: — Dylan Harper scored 17 points, Victor Wembanyama added 12 points, 11 rebounds and three blocks and the San Antonio Spurs rolled to their fifth straight victory, topping the Utah Jazz 119-97 on Monday night.

articles.headline: Alperen Sengun leads Rockets past Celtics 109-93 as Houston moves into first in West
articles.description: — Alperen Sengun had 26 points, 10 assists and seven rebounds to lead the Houston Rockets to a 109-93 win over the Boston Celtics on Monday night.
